jobs.title: Lead Closer for Healthcare Clinic
jobs.description: We are looking for a Lead Closer for our Acupuncture & Wellness Clinic in Cedar Park, TX, that is "Results-Oriented". We understand everybody has different definitions of what it means to be "Results-Oriented". Our Definition of "Results-Oriented" means: - you are only focused on the Results you produce for our patients, and not the effort you put in - not wanting recognition for effort, as you will always be rewarded for achieving Results that our patients want. - not expecting rewards and compensation, for not achieving the Results that our patients want Company: Achieve Integrative Health Job Description: - Primary Responsibility: Close Leads, provide 5 star service for all Leads. - Secondary Responsibility: provide 5 star concierge service for our current patients - Take on additional responsibilities based on your professional strengths. Work Hours: - Option 1 = full-time, US Central Standard Time (Graveyard shifts in Philippines/Indonesia) = ~8am-6pm cst (2 hr lunch break) Mon-Fri - Option 2 = Part-time, 1pm-6pm cst Mon-Fri Compensation Rules: - if you Qualify for this position via Criteria 1, then your starting base salary will by $7 USD/hr for the first 90 days. If you pass the 90 day probation, you will qualify for performance based bonuses in addition to your $7 USD/hr base. - if you qualify for this position via Criteria 2, then your starting 90 day probation salary will be $5/hr. If you pass the 90 day probation, you will qualify for performance based bonuses and your base compensation will be based on the results you produced during the 90 days. jobs.title: Systems Application Engineer: 1 Year Contract
jobs.description: You'll make a difference by: Providing Level 2 technical support for mission-critical applications , troubleshooting and resolving complex system issues during the maintenance and support phase in collaboration with internal technical teams and customers. Testing and validating system updates , supporting pre- and post-release testing of application, software, and firmware updates to ensure stability and performance. Investigating and resolving incidents and defects , conducting root cause analysis and implementing fixes to minimize operational disruption. Communicating technical findings and progress clearly to customers , ensuring transparency on issue status, resolution timelines, and corrective actions. Monitoring system health and performance , identifying risks proactively and supporting customers in maintaining system reliability. Assessing and coordinating support ticket escalation , prioritizing and collaborating with internal teams to resolve issues based on business impact. Your defining qualities: Strong foundation in IT systems and infrastructure , with a degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. 3–5 years of hands-on experience in Linux environments , including troubleshooting and system administration. 3–5 years of experience working with SQL and databases , with the ability to support data analysis and issue resolution. Familiarity with virtualization and infrastructure technologies , such as VMware, servers, storage, firewall, and networking environments. Experience working in a structured technical support or service environment , managing tickets within defined service levels. Customer-oriented and adaptable mindset , with strong communication skills and willingness to support after-hours or on-call when required.

jobs.title: Import Department Buyer
jobs.description: Position Overview : We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Supply Chain Associate / Import Buyer to join our growing team. The Supply Chain Associate handles communication with global suppliers and assists in the product development cycle. This role is essential in managing the end-to-end supply chain processes, particularly focused on international purchasing, vendor management, and ensuring timely and cost-effective importation of goods. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of global supply chains, procurement practices, and import regulations. Key responsibilities include : Vendor Management: Identify and establish relationships with international suppliers and negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts. Purchasing & Procurement: Manage the procurement of goods from international markets, ensuring the best quality, price, and delivery terms. Order Management: Place and track purchase orders, manage order confirmations, and resolve discrepancies with suppliers. Logistics Coordination: Coordinate shipments with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of imported goods. Import Documentation: Ensure all required documents (commercial invoices, bills of lading, certificates of origin, etc.) are accurate and compliant with international and local regulations. Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels and work with internal teams to ensure optimal inventory levels are maintained. Customs Compliance: Ensure adherence to all customs laws, regulations, and import/export guidelines, including tariff classifications and duty calculations. Cost Control: Analyze and manage procurement costs to align with budgetary goals and maximize savings. Vendor Performance Evaluation: Track supplier performance, delivery times, and quality, and work with vendors to improve service. jobs.title: Credit And Collection Staff
jobs.description: Position Overview : We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Credit and Collections Associate to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the credit evaluation process, monitoring outstanding balances, and ensuring timely collections from clients. This position plays a critical role in maintaining the company's cash flow and minimizing bad debt. The candidate will own the whole receivables process, such as posting, receiving and checking payments, issuing receipts, preparing statements, etc. Key responsibilities include : Credit Evaluation: Assist in assessing creditworthiness of new and existing customers by reviewing financial statements, credit reports, and payment histories. Collections: Contact clients to collect outstanding payments in a timely and professional manner, ensuring compliance with company policies. Payment Processing: Track incoming payments, accurately apply them to customer accounts, and resolve any discrepancies. Account Reconciliation: Regularly reconcile customer accounts to ensure balances are accurate and up to date. Aging Report Management: Maintain and monitor accounts receivable aging reports, following up on overdue accounts and escalating problematic cases as needed. Customer Communication: Build and maintain relationships with customers to resolve billing and payment issues, and negotiate payment plans when necessary. Credit Limits & Terms: Recommend credit limits and payment terms based on company guidelines and credit risk assessment. Dispute Resolution: Work with internal departments (sales, customer service, etc.) to resolve billing disputes and ensure smooth resolution. Reporting: Prepare regular reports on collection efforts, credit issues, and overall account status for management review. Compliance: Ensure that all credit and collection activities comply with company policies and legal regulations.
